This happens only once per creature and is a mind-affecting fear effect. The effigy's body parts stay preserved as by gentle repose, the effigy is treated as a magic item for saving throws, and an effigy used once can never be the target of this spell again

Creatures of the same type as the largest creature in the effigy — the same subtype, if that creature is a humanoid or outsider — take -2 on the save against the aura, and must make a Will save or become cursed as soon as they attack or damage the effigy from any distance or come within 10 feet of it. A creature closely related to or friends with anyone whose body built the effigy takes a further -4 on that save. Once a creature is cursed the spell on the effigy ends and the slot is freed, but the curse itself is permanent until removed

Tree of souls (minimum CL 11): the victim heals from rest at half rate, any magical healing on it must make a DC 20 caster level check or be negated, and it takes -4 on all Constitution-based checks including stabilisation checks and Fortitude saves.
